Test Case Description: Verify successful login with valid credentials returns both access and refresh tokens
PreRequisites:
- User account exists in NGUOIDUNG table
- Account is not locked (is_lock = false)
- User is not currently logged in
- Database is accessible
- JWT service is running
Steps to Perform: Navigate to login page (Web: /login or Desktop: launch app)
Step Expected Result: Login form is displayed with username field, password field, Đăng nhập button, Quên mật khẩu link, and Đăng ký link (Web only)
Test Case Expected Result: User successfully logs in and receives both JWT tokens (access + refresh). System redirects to role-specific home page (Customer → Web home, Staff/Admin → Desktop dashboard). Tokens are stored in local storage.

Step Expected Result: Username is displayed in the field
Loading indicator appears briefly, then system processes authentication

- Access token and refresh token are received
- Tokens are stored in local storage
- User is redirected to role-specific home page
- Home page displays user full name in header
- Role-specific navigation menu is visible
- Logout button is available
